messages:
elaine: OK team — dropping RFC follow-up: adhesion refactor proposal. TL;DR: split the runtime's admission/validation surface into a thin facade + stable core so service slices can be extracted independently. proposing phased extract + safety ladder.

sam: +1. can you sketch rollback/upgrade path?

elaine: phase 0: create facade shim behind feature flag. phase 1: route a small % of internal traffic, run canary validations. phase 2: enable tenant opt-in. phase 3: redirect default, keep old impl as fallback for 2 weeks, then remove.

maria: main concern: KV cache ownership and latency cliffs if validation becomes remote. need p99 budget and cache-affinity plan.

omar: agree. keep hotpath sync in facade for short-circuit checks (auth, fast-schema). heavier checks async/enrichment. interface idea:

```
POST /validate-sync -> {ok: bool, errors: []}
POST /validate -> {operation_id: str}
GET /validate/:operation_id -> {status, result}
```

elaine: adding that. also adding a circuit-breaker: if p99 latency > 120ms for 5m, route back to core impl automatically.

sam: how do we detect quality regressions? we need evals integrated into rollout. propose: run prompt-set A across both paths and compare:
- generation F1
- error rate
- latency buckets p50/p95/p99
Gate: fail rollout if F1 drops >1% or p99 increases >25% for 10k samples.

maria: +1. also need tenant-migration doc: mapping of tenant flags and config; will prep spreadsheet.

devops-bot: deploy-bot created canary cluster "adhesion-canary-1" in us-west-2 and reserved 2x A100 equivalent.

omar: adding perf harness snippet:

```
./tools/perf-run --endpoint https://adhesion-canary-1/api/validate-sync --concurrency 256 --duration 60
```

elaine: thanks — next steps:
- @maria prepare tenant migration spreadsheet by EOD Wed
- @sam wire eval harness and perf gates (I'll add thresholds)
- @omar add facade shim and circuit-breaker
I'll open a PR for the feature flag and test plan.

sam: will do. ping me when PR is up, I'll add perf tests.

maria: noted. I'll start doc and tag infra for secret rotation concerns.

elaine: cool. :thumbsup:
